chunks: So We heard his cry and relieved him of the misery he was in. We restored his family to him, and along with them gave him others similar to them as a grace from Us and reminder for those who are obedient.
ai.seo_question: How did God respond to Prophet Yunus's supplication in the whale?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the efficacy of sincere repentance (tawbah) and the specific supplication of Yunus, emphasizing that divine mercy extends beyond mere rescue to include the restoration of worldly blessings. The phrase 'and those like them' is interpreted by scholars such as Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni as indicating either the return of his family with additional members or the granting of spiritual progeny, serving as a lasting lesson (dhikra) for those devoted to God.
